label: STZA
notes: Pilot client for the pack engine (decided 14 Sep 2026). first_year_end is the end of STZA's first accounting period (12 Nov 2025 - 31 Mar 2026): the pack shows one full-year column per year since, adding one each year. tab_colours null means the STZA standard. Branding for the balance sheet recs workbook: mode is stza or client; a client sets logo_file (a bare file name in profiles/logos) and colours {primary, accent, band} as hex; anything missing or invalid falls back to STZA with a warning. Framework and year end mirror shared.clients; the design moves profiles into finance.pack_profiles. Output: STZA's own packs go to the Finance shared drive (Nik, 14 Sep 2026); other clients' packs go to their folder on the Clients drive.
